description: The traceability graph the requirements architect maintains. Relationship types follow BABOK v3 Trace Requirements (5.1.4.2); node types follow the core concepts and the requirements classification schema. Extensions beyond 5.1 are marked and anchored to the BABOK section they rest on.

nodeTypes.label: Need
nodeTypes.description: A problem or opportunity to be addressed (Business Analysis Core Concept Model).

nodeTypes.label: Requirement
nodeTypes.description: A usable representation of a need: business, stakeholder, solution or transition, per the requirements classification schema.

nodeTypes.label: Business rule
nodeTypes.description: A policy or rule the solution must satisfy (Business Rules Analysis).

nodeTypes.label: Design
nodeTypes.description: A usable representation of a solution (Requirements and Designs).

nodeTypes.label: Test
nodeTypes.description: A test case or acceptance criterion that can determine whether the solution fulfils a requirement (Acceptance and Evaluation Criteria).

nodeTypes.label: Value
nodeTypes.description: The worth of a change to a stakeholder (Business Analysis Core Concept Model).

nodeTypes.label: Stakeholder
nodeTypes.description: A group or individual with a relationship to the change, the need or the solution.

nodeTypes.label: Source
nodeTypes.description: A document, session or record that business analysis information came from (Confirm Elicitation Results).

edgeTypes.label: Derives from
edgeTypes.description: A requirement derived from another requirement at a different level of abstraction.

edgeTypes.label: Depends on
edgeTypes.description: A requirement that depends on another, by necessity or by effort.

edgeTypes.label: Satisfies
edgeTypes.description: An implementation element or design satisfying a requirement.

edgeTypes.label: Verifies
edgeTypes.description: A test case or other element that can determine whether the solution fulfils a requirement.

edgeTypes.label: Realises
edgeTypes.description: A requirement or design that delivers value toward a business objective (Validate Requirements).

edgeTypes.label: Raised by
edgeTypes.description: A need or requirement and the stakeholder it came from.

edgeTypes.label: Cites
edgeTypes.description: A requirement and the source that evidences it.
